papers.title: Microstructural evolution and mechanical properties of laser directed energy deposited Ti-6Al-4V after isothermal and cyclic annealing heat treatment
papers.first_author_affiliation: School of Mechanical Engineering, Jiangsu University, Zhenjiang 212000, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: Haifei Lu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Mechanical Engineering, Jiangsu University, Zhenjiang 212000, PR China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了热处理对定向能量沉积Ti-6Al-4V微观结构和力学性能的影响，直接符合后处理控制方向。
llm.why_not_core: 摘要未提供，但根据标题和会议，可能缺乏疲劳性能数据或仅限于拉伸性能。

summary_zh.motivation: 探索退火工艺对激光定向能量沉积Ti-6Al-4V组织与性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 对试样进行等温和循环退火处理，表征微观结构和力学性能。
summary_zh.result: 两种退火均显著改善组织均匀性和拉伸性能，循环退火效果更优。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸测试和显微观察验证力学与微观结构变化。

summary_en.motivation: This study investigates the effect of isothermal and cyclic annealing on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Ti-6Al-4V fabricated by laser directed energy deposition.
summary_en.method: Samples were subjected to isothermal and cyclic annealing heat treatments, followed by microstructural characterization and tensile testing.
summary_en.result: Both annealing routes improved microstructural homogeneity and tensile properties, with cyclic annealing yielding superior performance.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed via tensile tests and microscopy to correlate microstructural evolution with mechanical response.

papers.title: Improving surface quality of LDED thin-wall Ti-6Al-4V alloy with ultralow influence on superficial layer via femtosecond laser polishing
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering and Automation, Harbin Institute of Technology, Harbin 150001, China

corresponding_authors.name: Wentai Ouyang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Research Centre for Laser Extreme Manufacturing, Ningbo Institute of Materials Technology and Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Ningbo 315201, China

corresponding_authors.name: Xiaoming Duan
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering and Automation, Harbin Institute of Technology, Harbin 150001, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了飞秒激光抛光对LDED Ti-6Al-4V薄壁件表面质量的影响，属于后处理工艺，与方向高度相关。
llm.why_not_core: The paper focuses on surface quality rather than fatigue or tensile mechanical performance, lacking direct mechanical testing data.

summary_zh.motivation: 改善激光定向能量沉积Ti-6Al-4V薄壁件的表面质量。
summary_zh.method: 采用飞秒激光抛光进行后处理。
summary_zh.result: 表面粗糙度显著降低，且对表层影响极小。
summary_zh.validation: 通过表面形貌和截面微观结构表征验证。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the surface quality of laser-directed energy deposited thin-wall Ti-6Al-4V alloy for enhanced performance.
summary_en.method: Femtosecond laser polishing is applied as a post-processing technique to reduce surface roughness.
summary_en.result: The surface roughness is significantly reduced while minimizing damage to the superficial layer.
summary_en.validation: Surface morphology and cross-sectional microstructure characterization confirm the effectiveness.
